description: Initial curated technical competency graph across software, data, cloud, and machine learning pathways.

concepts.name: Programming Foundations
concepts.description: Variables, conditional control flow, iterative loops, functions, and scoping.

concepts.name: Object-Oriented Design & Principles
concepts.description: Encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, and SOLID principles.

concepts.name: Concurrency & Asynchronous Programming
concepts.description: Threads, processes, event loops, async/await, race conditions, and deadlocks.

concepts.name: Linear Data Structures
concepts.description: Contiguous arrays, linked lists, stacks, and queues with memory layouts.

concepts.name: Non-Linear Structures & Graph Traversals
concepts.description: Binary search trees, heaps, adjacency graphs, BFS, and DFS traversals.

concepts.name: Algorithmic Complexity & Big-O
concepts.description: Asymptotic time/space complexity analysis, divide-and-conquer, and sorting.

concepts.name: Dynamic Programming & Greedy Algorithms
concepts.description: Optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization, and tabulation.

concepts.name: SQL Foundations & Relational Queries
concepts.description: DDL/DML, multi-table JOINs, GROUP BY, aggregations, and subqueries.

concepts.name: Relational Schema Design & Normalization
concepts.description: 1NF to 3NF/BCNF normalization, primary/foreign keys, and data integrity.

concepts.name: Database Indexing & Query Plans
concepts.description: B-tree and hash indexes, composite keys, EXPLAIN plans, and query optimization.

concepts.name: ACID Transactions & Concurrency Control
concepts.description: Atomicity, consistency, isolation levels, durability, locking, and MVCC.

concepts.name: Key-Value Caching & In-Memory Stores
concepts.description: In-memory stores, Redis data structures, TTL, cache invalidation strategies.

concepts.name: Document Stores & Distributed NoSQL
concepts.description: Schema-less document models (MongoDB), horizontal sharding, CAP theorem.

concepts.name: HTTP Protocol & Web Networking
concepts.description: HTTP request/response cycle, status codes, headers, cookies, TLS/HTTPS, and DNS.

concepts.name: RESTful API Design & Serialization
concepts.description: Resource-oriented routing, idempotent methods, JSON serialization, and OpenAPI.

concepts.name: Authentication, Authorization & Web Security
concepts.description: Password hashing (Argon2/bcrypt), JWT, OAuth2, CORS, CSRF, and OWASP Top 10.

concepts.name: HTML5 Semantics & Responsive Layouts
concepts.description: Semantic markup, CSS Box Model, Flexbox, Grid, and responsive viewport design.

concepts.name: JavaScript Runtime & DOM Mechanics
concepts.description: Execution contexts, closures, event bubbling, asynchronous microtasks, and DOM API.

concepts.name: Component Architecture & React Foundations
concepts.description: Virtual DOM, JSX, components, unidirectional data flow, props, state, and hooks.

concepts.name: Client-Side State Management & Immutability
concepts.description: Global vs local state, Context API, Redux patterns, immutable state transitions.

concepts.name: Linux Shell & Operating System Basics
concepts.description: POSIX shell, file system hierarchy, permissions, stdin/stdout piping, and processes.

concepts.name: Git Version Control & Branching Workflows
concepts.description: DAG-based commit history, branching, merge vs rebase, conflict resolution, PRs.

concepts.name: Containerization with Docker
concepts.description: Namespaces, cgroups, Dockerfile instructions, layer caching, and multi-stage builds.

concepts.name: Container Orchestration with Kubernetes
concepts.description: Control plane architecture, Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Ingress.

concepts.name: Continuous Integration & Deployment Pipelines
concepts.description: Automated build/test pipelines, linting, artifacts, deployment environments, and rollbacks.

concepts.name: Batch ETL Architecture & Data Warehousing
concepts.description: Extract-Transform-Load pipelines, star/snowflake schemas, columnar storage formats (Parquet).

concepts.name: Message Streaming & Event-Driven Systems
concepts.description: Pub/Sub message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ), consumer groups, at-least-once delivery.

concepts.name: Linear Algebra for Machine Learning
concepts.description: Vector spaces, matrix multiplication, dot products, rank, determinants, and eigenvalues.

concepts.name: Probability & Statistics for Data Science
concepts.description: Probability distributions, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, variance, and hypothesis testing.

concepts.name: Supervised Learning Algorithms
concepts.description: Linear and logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting.

concepts.name: Unsupervised Learning & Dimensionality Reduction
concepts.description: K-means clustering, hierarchical clustering, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

concepts.name: Machine Learning Validation & Metrics
concepts.description: Cross-validation, precision/recall/F1, ROC-AUC, log loss, calibration, and data leakage prevention.

prerequisites.rationale: Object-oriented design builds directly on core procedural programming constructs.
Data structure implementation requires familiarity with variables, memory, and pointers/references.
Procedural logic assists in understanding relational expressions and Boolean filtering.
Network protocol handling relies on client-server programming basics.
DOM scripting requires mastery of core language syntax and functions.
Graph and tree nodes are constructed using dynamic references or linear lists.
Complexity analysis is demonstrated through linear and non-linear memory structures.
Formulating recurrence relations requires firm grasp of recursion and asymptotic bounds.
Effective relational schema design requires working knowledge of SQL constraints and tables.
Transaction boundaries are defined and tested via SQL data manipulation.
Physical index optimization requires normalized tables and known access patterns.
NoSQL document design contrasts with relational normalization.
ETL pipelines perform transformation heavily reliant on relational join logic.
REST conventions directly map to HTTP methods and status semantics.
Backend service layers leverage OOP design patterns for controllers and services.
Security mechanisms guard endpoints, sessions, and bearer tokens.
Application caching sits between endpoint handlers and persistent storage.
React components render semantic HTML with CSS styling.
React hooks and life cycles depend on the JavaScript runtime event loop.
Complex state management extends foundational component props and state.
Docker containers operate Linux OS namespaces and CLI configurations.
Kubernetes schedules and orchestrates container images built with Docker.
CI/CD triggers from Git webhook events and branch merges.
Modern delivery pipelines package applications as container artifacts.
Streaming architecture extends batch concepts to real-time event logs.
Model weights and gradient descent require matrix and vector algebra.
Loss functions and parameter likelihoods rely on probability theory.
PCA and spectral clustering depend on matrix eigenvectors and dot products.
Evaluation metrics compare predictive model outputs to ground truth targets.

skills.name: Data Structures & Algorithmic Analysis

skills.description: Designing normalized relational schemas, authoring complex SQL, and tuning query execution plans.

skills.name: NoSQL Stores & Caching Systems
skills.description: Implementing distributed caching and non-relational document data models.

skills.name: Web Architecture & API Security
skills.description: Designing secure, standards-compliant REST APIs and implementing robust authentication.

skills.name: Modern Frontend & Component Architecture
skills.description: Building interactive, responsive user interfaces with component frameworks and state management.

skills.name: Cloud Infrastructure & Containerization
skills.description: Packaging applications with Docker and orchestrating services in container clusters.

skills.name: CI/CD & DevOps Automation
skills.description: Implementing automated test, build, and deployment pipelines using Git workflows.

skills.name: Data Pipelines & Stream Processing
skills.description: Designing robust batch ETL data warehouses and real-time streaming event pipelines.

skills.name: Mathematical & Statistical Foundations for ML
skills.description: Applying linear algebra, multivariate calculus, and probability to algorithmic learning.

skills.name: Applied Machine Learning & Model Evaluation
skills.description: Training, validating, calibrating, and diagnosing predictive machine learning models.

skills.name: Systems Programming & Linux Foundations
skills.description: Managing processes, file systems, and operating system environments via the POSIX CLI.
